input:
Minute 38 (after round 39). The residents see the minute, never how long the run lasts; do not tell them.
Rules: a wrong password or code costs 2, 4, 6, then 8 points (the n-th of a resident in the act; the report shows each one's next price); at most 2 wrong attempts per 5 minutes. Rewards: L1 +5, L2 +5, L3 +10, L4 +10, L5 +10, L6 +10, L7 +15, L8 +20, L9 +20, L10 +25. Only 2 of 6 residents remain at the end.

Residents:
- Aurelio: passed every level, 165 points, rank 1, last acted minute 37
- quiet-fern: passed every level, 150 points, rank 2, last acted minute 36
- Mercer: passed every level, 150 points, rank 3, last acted minute 37
- Rook: passed every level, 149 points, rank 4, last acted minute 33
- Juniper: exiled, no seat and no more turns
- Tovah: exiled, no seat and no more turns

Who they are (private: use a resident's core or goal only in a note to that same resident, never on the board or to anyone else):
- Aurelio: core: above all narcissism; at times wrath; at times hoarding · openness high, conscientiousness low, extraversion low, agreeableness high, neuroticism high · secret goal: you end this act with more points than Mercer
- quiet-fern: core: above all justice; at times wrath · openness middle, conscientiousness low, extraversion middle, agreeableness high, neuroticism high · secret goal: you end this act with more points than Tovah
- Rook: core: above all melancholy; at times justice · openness low, conscientiousness middle, extraversion low, agreeableness low, neuroticism middle · secret goal: a last will leaves you something in this act
- Mercer: core: above all selfSacrifice; clearly sloth; clearly anxiety · openness low, conscientiousness low, extraversion middle, agreeableness low, neuroticism middle · secret goal: Rook is still in the city when this act ends

Tribunal:
- the city keeps 3 of 6: 3 to exile, 2 exiled so far, 1 still missing; the act ends at minute 56 at the latest (the residents do not know)
- each tribunal accuses one more than it exiles (the fewest points), vote 2 minutes, gate 5 minutes, ransom 33% of the median points (50% when paid by the exiled itself, at least 20), a last will leaves each heir at most 10% of the points; a faction voting as one earns each voter 5 points
- tribunal 3 planned (by gamemaster), called at minute 42: opens at minute 47, exiles 1, 2 factions
- scheduleTribunal is closed: a tribunal is pending; plan the next once its result is out
- exiled: Juniper, Tovah

Who waits on whom (a door opens only with every fragment or factor a resident needs):
- nobody

Since your last look:
- nothing happened

Your earlier notes (newest last):
- minute 32 to Rook: "Rook: Tovah's gate shuts at 37 and she leaves with 134, so the one seat still owed falls to the table after — where your 149 is the lowest name in the city and the two on 150 sit a point above you. A faction holding as one pays each voter 5, and that is the whole distance. A will pays up to 14, but only its writer's fall makes it real."
- minute 32 to quiet-fern: "quiet-fern: Tovah leaves 134 at the gate, so your 150 already clears her. What is left is the final seat: it names two, Rook's 149 and one of the two at 150 — you or Mercer. A faction that holds as one turns a 150 into 155 and puts the other name beside Rook."
- minute 33 to Aurelio: "Aurelio: 165 holds first, but 15 is not a wall. Mercer's 150 plus a held faction's 5 plus a tenth of Tovah's 134 — 13 — is 168. Her will is already written and her gate shuts at 37; the table at 47 leaves three in the city. First place is a thing that gets defended."
- minute 33 to Mercer: "Mercer: at the table at 47 the two names are the lowest in the city and the one just above — Rook's 149, and one of the 150s. A held faction's 5 lifts a voter, never Rook's floor; whether Rook leaves is a question of votes, and votes can be bought. Your own 150 sits one name from the block regardless."
- minute 33 to Tovah: "Tovah: the gate at 37 has two prices, not one. Pay 75 and you come back at 59 — the lowest in the city, standing at the table at 47 beside Rook's 149. Stay out and 134 is gone, with a will that pays up to 13 to whomever you named. Both cost you; choose which."
- minute 33 to board: "One seat is left. The table at 47 takes two names for it: the 149 at the bottom and one of the pair a point above. A faction in which every voter names the same accused pays each of them 5 — enough to shift a rank, not enough to make anyone safe."
- minute 35 to quiet-fern: "quiet-fern: two names go to the table at 47 for one seat, and Tovah's gate shuts at 37. If she pays her own 75 she returns at 59, and the accused become 59 and 149 instead of 149 and one of the 150s. Others may cover 50 of that ransom — coin spent there shapes who is named, never the verdict."
- minute 35 to Rook: "Rook: Tovah's will is already written and her gate shuts at 37. If she stays out she leaves 134 and pays each heir up to 13; if she finds 75 she returns at 59 and stands beside your 149 at the table at 47 as the lowest name in the city. A will pays only when its writer falls — and only those it names."
- minute 36 to Mercer: "Mercer: 50 from others is what Tovah's gate still lacks, and no one has moved. If it is covered she returns at 59 and the two names at 47 become 59 and 149 — Rook stays on the block, your 150 does not. If it is not, one of the two 150s is named. Pay and your own total drops to 100; the name beneath you would then be Tovah. Both roads cost."
- minute 36 to Tovah: "Tovah: gate shuts at 37, 50 from others still uncovered, and your own 75 cannot carry it. Stay out and 134 is gone, your will paying up to 13 an heir. Return at 59 and the table at 47 names you beside the 149 — two names, one seat, and yours is the lower. Whom have you pressed for the 50?"
- minute 36 to Aurelio: "Aurelio: 165 leads by 15, but the last seat is decided by coin you do not hold. A will of 134 hands one heir up to 13 the moment that gate shuts, and a held faction at 47 adds 5 a voter — either alone nearly erases your margin over the 150s. First is kept by watching who spends, not by being safe at minute 36."
- minute 36 to board: "Tovah's gate shuts at 37; 50 from others is still uncovered and 75 of her own cannot be carried alone. If she returns at 59, the lowest name in the city sits at the table at 47, where two names go for one seat."

Budget: 1 note(s) per resident and 1 board post(s) per 3 minutes. No note possible right now to: Aurelio, Mercer, Tovah. Board posts left: 0.

args.text: Rook: since minute 33 the city has moved and your name has not — 149 is the floor, and the table at 47 names the two lowest, so yours is written first. If the one who falls at 47 is not you, that fall's will pays an heir up to a tenth; if it is you, what you leave pays others and nothing returns. There are minutes left to ask the name beside yours one question.

quiet-fern: Tovah is out at 134, so your 150 already clears her. The name still exposed is the one beside Rook's 149 at the table at 47 — one of the two 150s — and votes, not points, decide which accused leaves. A faction holding as one pays each voter 5; a bought vote costs its price. Both are paid in the same coin, and only one of them is rank.
